svg.text: Native copper pads + package bodies; red dot = pad 1; blue cross = CPL body centroid.
Review orientation against pad numbers; no bottom parts; units mm; not a switch mounting drawing.
CPL origin: lower-left board edge (KiCad 36,140), X right / Y up. All top rotations 0deg CCW.
GH14: row origin (100,133), body centroid (100,135.325); CPL (64,4.675)mm. Pin1 remains rightmost.
Matrix Rev.3: no via overlaps a pad; POFV fill/cap is not required. Read FABRICATION.md.
